span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A low-dose stressor breaks homeostasis and triggers a compensatory response that overshoots the inhibition, producing facilitation early on.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: With continued exposure the compensatory response is exhausted, so the inhibitory effect of the noise comes to dominate.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Glutamate acting on hippocampal NMDA receptors admits calcium and thereby changes synaptic plasticity, which is the substrate of learning and memory.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: The behavioural swing is mediated by the hippocampal glutamate level, which is raised by short exposure and lowered by long exposure.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The direction of the effect reverses with exposure duration, which the paper identifies as hormesis - excitation at low dose, inhibition at high
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Dose for noise is not the level but the level multiplied by the duration, which is why the same decibel figure sits on both sides of the curve
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The reversal is attributed to a compensatory response that outruns the insult at first and is then exhausted
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The behavioural reversal is tracked by glutamate, which rises early and falls late while GABA stays flat
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Glutamate has its own inverted-U: more release aids learning until excitotoxicity sets in
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Combined road and rail noise is not the sum of its parts - the two sources differ in continuity, peak level and low-frequency content
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The extrapolation from mice to human cognitive ability is explicitly only a speculation awaiting human testing.
span.note: what this limits: the human relevance of the whole study: THIS SPECULATION NEEDS TO BE VERIFIED BY ADDITIONAL COGNITIVE BEHAVIOR TESTS IN HUMANS EXPOSED TO 70 dB(A) CTN
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The compensatory-response account of the biphasic effect is inferred rather than measured.
span.note: what this limits: the mechanistic account of the biphasic effect: IT WAS SPECULATED THAT THE COMPENSATORY RESPONSE WAS GREATER THAN THE INHIBITORY RESPONSE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: RETRACTED (NEITHER ENDPOINT APPEARS IN THE SPAN, IN ANY FORM) · Glu —part-of→ NMDA
span.note: RETRACTED: NEITHER ENDPOINT APPEARS IN THE SPAN, IN ANY FORM. The edge is `Glu --part-of--> NMDA`. The span reads: 'Quotation withheld' It names magnesium, calcium and synaptic plasticity, and neither glutamate nor the NMDA receptor - not as an abbreviation, not as a morphological variant, not at all. Checked against the three explanations that accounted for most of the unattested population (Q-340): derivational morphology, the paper's own acronyms, and irregular plurals. None applies. WHAT THE SPAN DOES SAY (Q-309): a real mechanism between different terms, housed below. Q-267 would reject this edge today; it predates the rule, which is the stratum Q-340 was written to sweep. — strength of the relation: 1

span.note: RETRACTED: NEITHER ENDPOINT APPEARS IN THE SPAN. The edge is `epidemiological survey --contrasted-with--> ICR`. The span is a single sentence about methodology: 'Quotation withheld' It names neither epidemiological surveys nor the ICR mouse strain. The contrast the edge records may well be one the paper draws - laboratory animal work against epidemiological survey - but IT IS NOT DRAWN HERE, and 'this shortage' is an anaphor pointing at a sentence the span does not include. WHAT THE SPAN DOES SAY (Q-309): that controlled animal exposure compensates for a shortcoming named elsewhere. That is a methodological endorsement with its referent outside the span, so nothing is kept for these endpoints. — strength of the relation: 0.9
